lines.text: OK. You went in your house and this is about quarter to four.

lines.text: And then what did you do in your house. Be honest so we don’t have ta go though this eight times.

lines.text: I went into my room and cuz my mom told me I had ta clean my room. I cleaned it a little bit and then played Playstation 2 for a little bit and it was about like 5:00 and my, my brother was on the phone with his friend.

lines.text: And he was talking about going trick or treating with ‘em and that Jason will pick him up at like seven.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And then I ate and then went into the living room at and like I was like eating in the living room and watchin’ TV.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well then, then he called and said that he wanted help on his his car.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, did he call you or did he come over?
